name: Eternal Orb
description: Creates an imprint of an item for later restoration. The imprint can't be applied to Fractured Items
directions: Right click this item then left click on an item to create an imprint. This imprint can later be used to restore this specific item to that imprinted state.
consoleDirections: X to use, then A on an item to create an imprint. This imprint can later be used to restore this specific item to that imprinted state.
